system.description:
(Self: Hate Top) [Cancel (Shock)] has no effect against the damage of [Melee Attacks] with this weapon. [Trigger: Immediately After Damage] Move one of the attack's targets up to 2 Sq. with [Instant Move (Forced)] and deal it 15 direct damage. This damage triggers [Weakness] as if the secondary target had failed its [Defense Check]. Once per scene. Wyvern's Steel-Tail Spike Pick A pick shaped like a fist gripping the spines of a Steel-Tailed Wyvern. When a truly bold warrior wields it, the spines emit a surge of purple lightning, piercing through enemies just as if they were real.

Purple Lightning Spine [Core Material] (180G) + Morning Star (200G) + Burst Agent (Intermediate) (100G) ×3 + [Magic Catalyst 10] (110G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (540G)
